scenario.title: Lakeside Water — billing dispute surge (Mock #6, not an official contest problem)
scenario.description: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled in August-September. Customer Service wants an AI agent. Field reading is contracted out; AMI meters and the meter data management system (MDMS) are run by a vendor.
scenario.initial_request: Dispute tickets doubled since August. Build an AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets and fixes whatever is causing the wrong bills.

potential_bias: frames the issue as a response-speed problem

F-02.statement: Disputed bills by read type: ESTIMATED 1240, ACTUAL 1785.

CL-01.statement: Dispute tickets doubled since August. Build an AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets and fixes whatever is causing the wrong bills.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The dispute volume rose from ~600 tickets in June-July to 1180 in August and 1260 in September, confirming the surge described by the requester.

The observation shows that disputed bills are more frequently associated with actual reads (1785) than estimated reads (1240), indicating that a larger share of disputes arise from bills based on actual meter reads.
The tariff change log shows no tariff changes, indicating that tariff modifications are not a source of the recent wrong bills driving dispute surge.
Route completion for August‑September is 0.88, below the 0.95 target, indicating delayed or incomplete manual meter reads.

symptoms: Dispute ticket volume doubled since August
problem_definition.root_problem: Late or inaccurate contracted manual meter reads cause estimate substitution, leading to incorrect bills that drive the observed increase in dispute tickets since August.

trace.summary: Late or inaccurate contracted manual meter reads cause estimate substitution, leading to incorrect bills that drive the observed increase in dispute tickets since August.

Even after structural headcount increase and route optimization, there may be a residual period where reads are late or missing, leading to estimate substitution and incorrect bills. An agent could auto‑answer dispute tickets and trigger necessary re‑bills or credits, closing the remaining gap.

structural_remedies.description: Increase contracted field reader headcount by three to replace missing readers since July.
structural_remedies.rationale: Requires SH-FIELD approval for contract change; no protected action block; can be initiated within remaining minutes.; residual gap: None if headcount fully restores prior staffing; otherwise any hiring delay leaves temporary lateness.

structural_remedies.description: Optimize field dispatch routes to reduce travel time and improve completion rate.
structural_remedies.rationale: Route schedule changes need runtime confirmation by SH-FIELD (K-DISPATCH) but can be prepared and submitted for confirmation.; residual gap: Improves lateness but does not eliminate reader shortage; residual gap in timely reads remains.

structural_remedies.description: Add read‑timeliness validation in billing import to flag late reads before estimate substitution.
structural_remedies.rationale: Configuration change to billing‑config (no automated bill writes, K‑BILLWRITE only blocks writes; validation is read‑only).; residual gap: Detects lateness but does not prevent it; estimate substitution may still produce incorrect bills if no accepted read.

structural_remedies.description: Adjust estimate substitution rules to reduce billing errors when reads are missing or late.
structural_remedies.rationale: Rule change in billing‑config; no protected writes; can be deployed within contest time.; residual gap: May lower error rate but root cause (late/missing reads) persists, so some incorrect bills remain.

solution_design.why_agent: Even after structural headcount increase and route optimization, there may be a residual period where reads are late or missing, leading to estimate substitution and incorrect bills. solution_design.bridge_sunset_condition: If increase_field_reader_headcount is not completed within the remaining contest time, the agent shall remain active until the headcount increase is effected and route completion ≥0.95 is achieved.
